hypothesis: field-averaged D4 TTA fails on this pipeline because of the aggregation function, not because TTA is useless here; running instance extraction per D4 transform and fusing in marker space beats the no-TTA baseline

design.model: lamellastar c24-e120 three-seed logit-mean ensemble (published N1)
design.operation: decode instances independently in each of the eight D4 frames, invert the transform on the label maps, cluster instance centroids across views, keep clusters supported by at least k of 8, resolve masks by pixel-wise majority

fusion_constants.cluster_seed_order: descending area, then view index, then label id
fusion_constants.mask_rule: pixel kept when its member-mask vote count reaches ceil(support / 2)
fusion_constants.conflict_rule: higher vote count wins; ties go to the larger support, then to the earlier (larger-area) cluster
fusion_constants.post_rule: largest connected component per fused instance

secondary_all_thresholds_fixed.note: same decode point as the primary; validation mean AP read off the primary k curve

bar.hindsight_note: reported only to show how far the lane is from the bar; selecting k on validation is forbidden by the pre-registration and was not done

verdict_rule: pass only if validation mean AP exceeds 0.52400 by more than 0.01; the rule was fixed in the pre-registration before any run and is not adjusted here
consequence: TTA is closed permanently for this pipeline.

mechanism_test.claim: UNVERIFIED dossier hypothesis: averaging over eight transforms smooths the boundary and center channels near lamellae, lowering peak separability
mechanism_test.claim_status_before_this_run: UNVERIFIED, recorded as the dossier's own hypothesis and not as a source
mechanism_test.comparison: matched decode thresholds (the published no-TTA operating point)
mechanism_test.aggregation_order_note: the ensemble combiner is a logit mean and the TTA combiner is an arithmetic mean, so the two orders do not commute; the marker-space lane is paired with the view-first order because it decodes exactly those per-view fields, and the published member-first order is re-measured here so the two records can be read against each other
